title: DELETE /api/users/me — soft delete account
description: Soft delete the user's account by setting deleted_at. Invalidates all sessions. All their projects and data remain for potential recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Requires { confirmPassword: string } body to prevent accidents
Deletes all refresh tokens (forces logout everywhere)
Subsequent login attempts with this email return 401

steps.details: Validate { confirmPassword: string }. Fetch user. If user has password, bcrypt.compare(confirmPassword, user.passwordHash) — return 401 if wrong. Set user.deleted_at = NOW(). Delete all refresh_tokens for user. Clear cookie. Return 200.
Delete account with correct password. Try logging in with same email — expect 401. Check DB — user has deleted_at set, data still present.
